name: Dimension type code qualifier
description: Code qualifying the type of the dimension.

values.name: Gross dimensions
values.description: Gross dimensions The dimension expressed in a gross value.

values.name: Package dimensions (including goods)
values.description: Package dimensions (including goods) The dimension of the goods including the packaging.

values.name: Pallet dimensions (excluding goods)
values.description: Pallet dimensions (excluding goods) The dimension of a pallet excluding the goods.

values.name: Pallet dimensions (including goods)
values.description: Pallet dimensions (including goods) The dimension of a pallet including the goods.

values.name: Off-standard dimension front
values.description: Off-standard dimension front The dimension in the length that the cargo exceeds the standard length at the front of an equipment.

values.name: Off-standard dimension back
values.description: Off-standard dimension back The dimension in the length that the cargo exceeds the standard length at the back of an equipment.

values.name: Off-standard dimension right
values.description: Off-standard dimension right The dimension in the width that the cargo exceeds the standard width at the right side of an equipment.

values.name: Off-standard dimension left
values.description: Off-standard dimension left The dimension in the width that the cargo exceeds the standard width at the left side of an equipment.

values.name: Off-standard dimension general
values.description: Off-standard dimension general The dimensions that the cargo exceeds the standard dimensions.

values.name: External equipment dimension
values.description: External equipment dimension The external dimensions of transport equipment.

values.name: Internal equipment dimensions
values.description: Internal equipment dimensions The internal dimensions of equipment.

values.name: Damage dimensions
values.description: Damage dimensions Dimensions of the damaged area.

values.name: Off-standard dimensions height
values.description: Off-standard dimensions height The dimension in the height that the cargo exceeds the standard height at the top of a piece of equipment.

values.name: Equipment door dimensions
values.description: Equipment door dimensions Dimensions (width and height) of the equipment door.

values.name: Off-standard dimension width
values.description: Off-standard dimension width The dimension of the width that the cargo exceeds the standard width of a piece of equipment.

values.name: Off-standard dimension length
values.description: Off-standard dimension length The dimension of the length that the cargo exceeds the standard length of a piece of equipment.
